_schema_notes: One entry per state/province. sourceStatus 'migrated' means the content was transcribed from the legacy site's regulations page during the 2026-08-16 audit and should still be verified against the current permit before a move. sourceStatus 'placeholder' means the legacy content has not yet been migrated into this file -- the generated page will show a clear 'not yet migrated' notice instead of inventing regulatory content.

quickFacts.permitNeeded: Over 8'6" wide, over 14' high, or trailer over 57'6" long
quickFacts.specialInfo: Insurance must be on file with the permit office
quickFacts.travelWindow: Sunrise to sunset, Monday through Saturday. No travel Sundays.
quickFacts.holidayRestrictions: No movement on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, or Christmas. If a holiday falls on a day other than Monday or Saturday, the restriction runs from sunset the day before through sunrise the day after. If it falls on a Monday, movement is prohibited from sunset the preceding Saturday until sunrise the following Tuesday. If it falls on a Saturday, movement is prohibited from sunset the preceding Friday until sunrise the following Monday.
quickFacts.curfews: Albuquerque & Espanola: 7-9am and 4-6pm. Santa Fe: 7-9am and 11:30am-1:30pm and 4-6pm.

rules: Over 8'6" wide, if deemed a hazard: 1 pilot vehicle
Over 14' wide: 1 pilot vehicle in front on 2-lane roads, in rear on 4-lane roads
Over 20' wide for 5+ miles: police escort plus flagman
Over 90' up to 110' long: 1 pilot vehicle in front on 2-lane roads, in rear on 4-lane roads
Over 110' long: 2 pilot vehicles, front and rear
16' and over in height: 1 escort with height pole in front (plus an extra person or pilot vehicle to check overhead clearance)
18' and over in height: 1 escort with height pole in front and 1 pilot vehicle in rear (plus clearance coordination with utilities and local authorities)

equipmentRequirements.vehicle: Must be DOT-inspected annually with certification carried at all NM ports of entry. Wheelbase at least 100 inches; must not exceed 1.5 ton capacity. Insurance minimum 25/50/10, proof carried in the vehicle.
equipmentRequirements.signs: "OVERSIZE LOAD" sign, 5' x 1' minimum, black letters 10" x 1" on a yellow background, mounted front and rear or on top of the vehicle.
equipmentRequirements.lights: 2 rotating amber lights (rotating, flashing, or strobe) mounted on top at vehicle width (not to exceed 8'), visible at 1,000 feet minimum in normal sunlight.
equipmentRequirements.flags: 2 red or fluorescent orange flags, minimum 12" per side, mounted front and rear or on top.
equipmentRequirements.additional: Two-way radio; rear-view mirrors on both sides; one fire extinguisher (2.5 lb CO2 or dry chemical or equivalent); identification signage showing company name, address, and state authority number on both sides (removable magnetic signs are acceptable); 3 red flares or reflectors.

permitOffice.name: New Mexico Department of Public Safety, Motor Transportation Division

new-mexico.disclaimer: These are guidelines only and are subject to change without notice. Always verify current requirements against the permit issued by the pertinent permit office before a move.
